rollout.notes: Trained and evaluated by the trainer with first-order single-backtrace semi-Lagrangian advection. The paper's glyph-chain figures used WENO advection at inference.

data.source: 62 glyphs (A-Z, a-z, 0-9) x 8 font faces, face-major order
data.notes: Participation-ratio normalised (0.197*H*W). The build script and the identity of the 8 font faces were not recovered, so this pool cannot be regenerated exactly from the release.

training.provenance: No launch script was retained. Arguments reconstructed from the training log (resolution, k_max 0.0625, width 64 / modes 16 / 8 layers, 40000 steps, data path, cosine LR consistent with 40000 steps; lambda_mu 0.05 and lambda_ke 1.0 are consistent with the logged loss decomposition) and the checkpoint shapes. --batch-size 64 comes from the reconstructed recipe and is not printed in the log.
training.args_note: Flags of the original launch command (original entry point: fluidot_improved.train_2d). `--save-dir` is omitted; absolute data paths of the original run are rewritten relative to the repository root (data/...). `advection` is new in the release package and made explicit here; the original code hard-wired this scheme.
training.command: python -m viot.train_2d --resolution 256 --sampler pool --data-path data/font_letters_256.pt --batch-size 64 --lr 1e-4 --n-steps 40000 --n-rollout 10 --n-test 20 --n-infer-steps 50 --k-max 0.0625 --arch fno --fno-width 64 --fno-modes 16 --fno-layers 8 --bb-visc-only --lambda-ke 1.0 --lambda-mu 0.05 --advection semi_lagrangian
training.original_args_note: Relative to the original launch command: --sampler chinese -> pool (alias); --data-path .data/font_letters_256.pt -> data/font_letters_256.pt. Data files are expected under data/ (see scripts/data/README.md).

checkpoint.selection: model_best: lowest single-training-batch terminal loss among the checkpoints saved every 1000 steps (not a validation criterion)
checkpoint.state_dict_note: keys and tensors identical to the original .pt state_dict, including the trunc_mask buffer

end_of_training_eval_final_weights.note: terminal L2 printed by the trainer's end-of-training evaluation (seed 42) on the final weights of this run, not on this checkpoint; useful as a reference when retraining
